options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:

options.doc_fr:

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: Deathlink
options.doc: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.
options.doc_fr: Quand vous mourez, tous ceux qui ont permis la mort meurent. Bien sûr, l'inverse est vrai aussi.

options.name: Goal
options.doc:
The goal of the game.
Vanilla means the goal is to beat the World 5 boss.
Universal Bearing Collectable means the goal is to beat the secret exit in The Looking Glass.
Home means the goal is to beat home after collecting the Universal Bearing Collectable.
Home will be treated as the first secret exit if the goal is not Home.

options.name: Difficulty
options.doc:
What tricks will be factored into the game's logic.
Intended means that if an item makes a level easier in any way, it is required for logic.
Simple means that easily skippable items will not be required for logic.
Advanced means that any skippable items will not be required for logic.
Glitched means that any skippable items including glitches will not be required for logic.

options.name: Open World
options.doc:
How open the world is.
Closed means each level is unlocked individually.
Partial means standard exits are unlocked at the start.
Boss and Secret exits still need to be unlocked.
Open means that everything besides boss exits are unlocked at the start.
The Scenic Route's exit is also an exception.
Full means that all exits are unlocked at the start.
options.doc_fr:
Comme le monde est ouvert.
Fermé signifie que chaque niveau est déverrouillé individuellement.
Les sorties standard sont déverrouillées au début.
Les sorties Boss et Secret doivent encore être déverrouillées.
Open signifie que tout à part les sorties de boss sont déverrouillés au début.
La sortie de la Scenic Route est également une exception.
Full signifie que toutes les sorties sont déverrouillées au début.

options.name: Paths
options.doc:
How are Paths between levels unlocked.
Vanilla means that beating a level will unlock its corresponding path.
Randomized means that each level path will be an item in the pool.
Progressive means that progressive path items will be added to the pool.
While normal paths will be unlocked with Progressive Paths, 
paths to and from secret levels will be unlocked with Progressive Secret Paths.
options.doc_fr:
Comment sont les chemins entre les niveaux déverrouillés.
Vanille signifie que battre un niveau déverrouillera son chemin correspondant.
Randomized signifie que chaque chemin de niveau sera un élément dans le pool.
Progressive signifie que des éléments de chemin progressif seront ajoutés au pool.
Alors que les chemins normaux seront déverrouillés avec les chemins progressifs, les chemins vers et depuis les niveaux secrets seront déverrouillés avec les chemins secrets progressifs.

options.name: Entrance Rando
options.doc: Should level entrances be randomized.

options.name: Door Rando
options.doc:
Should doors in levels be randomized.
Two way doors are always excluded from door rando.
Full means that any door can lead to any other door.
Balanced means that any door can lead to any other door,
but levels will always have the same number of rooms as they had originaly.
Restricted means that doors can lead to any other door in the same level.
Disabled means that doors will not be randomized.

options.name: Roomsanity
options.doc:
Adds each room as a location.
This adds 210 locations so enable this with caution.
options.doc_fr:
Ajoute chaque chambre comme un emplacement.
Cela ajoute 210 emplacements afin de permettre cela avec prudence.

options.name: Checkpointsanity
options.doc:

This adds 41 locations.
options.doc_fr:
Ajoute chaque point de contrôle comme un emplacement.
Cela ajoute 41 emplacements.

options.name: Default Item Groups
options.doc:
How items will be grouped together by default.
To use Pop Blocks as an example:
Separated item groups means Standard Pop Blocks and Galactic Pop Blocks will be added to the pool.
Collecting each one will unlock its corresponding item.
Progressive item groups means two Progressive Pop Blocks will be added to the pool.
Collecting the first will unlock Standard Pop Blocks, and the second will unlock Galactic Pop Blocks.
Grouped item groups means Pop Blocks will be added to the pool.
Collecting it will unlock both Standard Pop Blocks and Galactic Pop Blocks.
Precollected item groups means no items will be added to the pool.
Both Standard Pop Blocks and Galactic Pop Blocks will be unlocked from the start.
options.doc_fr:
Comment les éléments seront regroupés par défaut.
Pour utiliser Pop Blocks comme exemple :
Les groupes d'articles séparés signifient que les blocs pop standard et les blocs pop galactiques seront ajoutés au bassin.
La collecte de chacun déverrouillera l'élément correspondant.
Les groupes d'articles progressifs signifient que deux blocs de pop progressifs seront ajoutés au bassin.
Collecter le premier débloquera les blocs pop standard, et le second débloquera les blocs pop galactiques.
Les groupes d'articles groupés signifient que Pop Blocks sera ajouté au pool.
La collecte va débloquer les blocs Pop Standard et Galactic.
Les groupes d'articles précollectés signifient qu'aucun article ne sera ajouté au pool.
Les blocs pop standard et les blocs pop galactiques seront déverrouillés dès le début.

options.name: Default Extra Items
options.doc:
Whether extra items are included by default.
How these extra items are added is dependent on the item's grouping.
To use Skull Rings as an example:
Separated item groups will have two Yellow Skull Rings, and two Blue Skull Rings in the pool.
Collecting the first of each will let you stop the corresponding Skull Ring from moving.
Collecting the second of each will neutralize the corresponding Skull Ring.
Progressive item groups will add a third additional Progressive Skull Ring to the pool.
Collecting the third Progressive Skull Ring will neutralize both types of Skull Rings.
Grouped item groups will add a second additional Skull Rings to the pool.
Collecting the second Skull Rings will neutralize both types of Skull Rings.
Precollected item groups means no items will be added to the pool.
Both types of Skull Rings will be neutralized from the start.
